title: Effect of Chitooligosaccharides on TLR2/NF-kappaB Signaling in LPS-Stimulated RAW 264.7 Macrophages.
authors: Zhao, Mengting; Pang, Shurong; Gao, Yiqing; Li, Ting; Jiang, Hongrui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究壳寡糖对LPS刺激巨噬细胞中TLR2/NF-kB信号通路的抗炎作用，虽含分子对接但对象为糖-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chitooligosaccharides (COSs), degraded products of chitosan or chitin, are attracting growing interest owing to their low degree of polymerization (DP), high solubility, and prominent anti-inflammatory activity. However, the correlation between their structure and anti-inflammatory activities still needs to be explored. In this study, we use LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 macrophages as an inflammatory model to systematically evaluate COS1-7 for their effects on inflammatory mediators and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. The results of Griess assay, ELISA, and real-time quantitative PCR show that COSs can inhibit the expression of NO, iNOS, and pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha, MCP-1 and IL-1beta), thereby attenuating inflammatory signaling. Notably, chitohexaose (COS6) exhibits the most significant anti-inflammatory effect, reducing the mRNA levels of LPS-induced iNOS, IL-6, and IL-1beta and the production of IL-6 and TNF-alpha by more than 50%. Transcriptome, western blotting, and real-time quantitative PCR analysis reveal that COSs can inhibit the activation of the NF-kappaB signal pathway by down-regulating TLR2 levels. Additionally, molecular docking confirms that COSs retard TLR2/4 dimerization and LPS recognition by TLR4, affecting downstream signaling cascades. In summary, this study provides a valuable insight into the potential anti-inflammatory mechanism of COSs and highlights the possible applications in human health promotion by modulating receptor-mediated signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 壳寡糖（COSs）是壳聚糖或甲壳素的降解产物，因其低聚合度（DP）、高溶解性和显著的抗炎活性而日益受到关注。然而，其结构与抗炎活性之间的关联仍需进一步探索。本研究以脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞为炎症模型，系统评估COS1-7对炎症介质和NF-kappaB信号通路的影响。Griess实验、ELISA和实时定量PCR结果表明，COSs能抑制NO、iNOS及促炎细胞因子（IL-6、TNF-alpha、MCP-1和IL-1beta）的表达，从而减弱炎症信号。值得注意的是，壳六糖（COS6）表现出最显著的抗炎效果，使LPS诱导的iNOS、IL-6和IL-1beta的mRNA水平以及IL-6和TNF-alpha的产生减少超过50%。转录组学、蛋白质印迹和实时定量PCR分析揭示，COSs通过下调TLR2水平抑制NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。此外，分子对接证实COSs阻碍TLR2/4二聚化及TLR4对LPS的识别，影响下游信号级联反应。总之，本研究为COSs潜在抗炎机制提供了有价值的见解，并强调了其通过调节受体介导信号通路在促进人类健康方面的可能应用。
